Systemless Lawnchair Launcher (Unofficial)

![GitHub release](https://github.com/Unofficial-Life/Lawnchair-Launcher-Module/releases)  

!Repo visits

> Note: This is an unofficial module. Do not request support in official Lawnchair channels, as doing so could result in a ban or kick from their community.

---

📑 Table of Contents

  • [Module Features](#-module-features)
  • [Important: Before Flashing ⚠️](#%EF%B8%8F-important-before-flashing)
  • [Installation](#-installation)
  • [Updating the Module Yourself](#-updating-the-module-yourself)
  • [Optional: Removing Lawnicons](#-optional-removing-lawnicons)
  • [Special Thanks](#-special-thanks-to)

    • ---

    🌟 Module Features

  • Systemless installation of Lawnchair Launcher via Magisk or KernelSU.
  • Supports Android versions 10 (Q) to 14 (QPR3).
  • **Quickswitch Integration**: Replaces Recents Provider without extra configuration.
  • Automatic updates via Magisk/KSU.

    • ---

    ⚠️ Important: Before Flashing

  • **Magisk Users:** Ensure "Enforce DenyList" is turned off.
  • **KSU Users:** Disable the "Unmount module by default" toggle.

    • ---

    📦 Installation

  • Download the zip file from the [Latest Release](https://github.com/Unofficial-Life/Lawnchair-Launcher-Module/releases/latest).
  • Flash the zip in Magisk or KernelSU.
  • Reboot and enjoy the Lawnchair experience!

    • ---

    🔄 Updating the Module Yourself

    To manually update or customize the module:

  • **Download the repository** as a [zip file](https://github.com/Unofficial-Life/Lawnchair-Launcher-Module/archive/refs/heads/main.zip).
  • **Extract the files** from the zip.
  • **Edit `module.prop`:**

    • - Remove the update.json line (to disable automatic updates from this repo).

  • **Clean up unnecessary files** such as `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, and `.github` folder (optional but recommended).
  • **Download the latest Lawnchair APK** from the [Lawnchair Modded Repo](https://github.com/Unofficial-Life/Lawnchair-Modded) or another version of your choice.
  • **Rename the APK** to `Dev.apk` and place it in `System/priv-app/dev`.
  • **Zip the folder** containing all files.
  • **Flash the new zip** through Magisk or KSU.

    • ---

    🛠 Optional: Removing Lawnicons

    If you do not want Lawnicons, simply delete the lawnicons folder from System/priv-app within the module zip before flashing.
